audit.whatIsWrong: Rows 1 (Level 2), 4 (Level 6) and 5 (First item) disagreed with the packet chart and with the mirror.
audit.why: Packet levelChart is Garen x5 then Yasuo, Yasuo. Stored rows had Level 2 = Skill, Level 6 = Skill, First item = Garen. The mirror audit set Level 2 -> Garen, Level 6 -> Garen, First item -> Yasuo, and the existing whys already read that way (whys[1] 'keeps you behind at level 2', whys[4] 'outmatches your ult', whys[5] 'finally flip the trades').
audit.corrected: Three rows flipped in BOTH layers as one atomic group with ratings rescaled from Yasuo's side.

audit.whatIsWrong: No cooldown numbers on either side.
audit.why: Decisive Strike 8s flat, Courage 22/19.5/17/14.5/12, Judgment 9/8.25/7.5/6.75/6, Demacian Justice 120/100/80, Last Breath 70/50/30.
audit.corrected: Numbers written into spikes[0], spikes[1], spikes[2], mid, phases[4].why, breakdown.cooldowns and dosFull[0].d.

audit.whatIsWrong: 'Last Breath converts ANY knockup into a kill window' is false in this matchup; Courage's tenacity was never mentioned; the R's resistance-bypass was not stated as an itemisation consequence.
audit.why: Nothing in Garen's kit is airborne-inducing, so your only Last Breath setup 1v1 is your own two-stack Steel Tempest whirlwind. Courage grants a shield AND tenacity, which shortens the knockup window you rely on. Demacian Justice is true damage, so stacking armour or MR does not answer it — HP and staying above the threshold do. The existing claim that Wind Wall does nothing against Garen is CORRECT and matches the mirror: he has no projectile in any slot.
audit.corrected: Q2 whirlwind named as the only setup; tenacity and true-damage consequences stated.

audit.whatIsWrong: Anti-heal is listed in the item block but never tied to a reason.
audit.why: Perseverance regenerates a percentage of max health per second when he has not recently taken damage — Grievous Wounds is what keeps your chip damage on him.

edits.before: Garen bullies you early — Decisive Strike (Q) silences you so you can't E-dash away and empowers his next auto, and Judgment (E) spins through your minions for heavy damage. Never sit in E range low, and don't dash in while his Q silence is up.
edits.after: Garen bullies you early — Decisive Strike (Q) is 8s and silences you, so your E dash is locked while it runs; Judgment (E) is 9s at rank 1 and spins through minions. Trade in the gap after the silence, never into it, and never stand in the spin low.

edits.before: Demacian Justice (R) is a true-damage execute that scales with your missing health, so his 6 is far deadlier than yours; keep your health high in trades and remember Wind Wall does nothing against his fully melee kit.
edits.after: Demacian Justice (R) is a 120s true-damage execute that grows with your missing health — resistances do nothing, so the answer is HP and disengage, not armour. Wind Wall is dead weight here: Garen has no projectile in any slot.

edits.before: Your turning point — with Berserker's and first-item crit you finally kite his Q-E: dash off minions, space outside Judgment, and punish the windows after his silence expires.
edits.after: Your turning point — first-item crit lets you kite his Q-E: dash off minions, space outside Judgment's 325 range, and trade in the window after his 8s silence expires.

edits.before: Garen falls off against a mobile crit Yasuo who refuses to stand in Judgment; once you have items you dash around his slow kit and duel him down, but respect the missing-health execute on his R.
edits.after: Garen falls off against a mobile crit Yasuo who refuses to stand in Judgment; with items you dash around his slow kit and duel him. Perseverance regenerates him out of combat, so Grievous Wounds keeps your chip on him.

edits.before: Through 3-6 you're behind — respect the Q silence before dashing, never linger in Judgment range, and keep your health up because his level 6 Demacian Justice executes low targets outright.
edits.after: Through 3-6 you're behind — his Q silence locks your dash while it runs, and Courage is 22s at rank 1 with tenacity, so your knockup window shrinks; stay high-HP against the execute.

edits.before: Last Breath converts ANY knockup into a kill window. Reassess every all-in at 6 — Garen's ultimate changes the math too.
edits.after: Last Breath (70s at rank 1) needs your own Q2 whirlwind — nothing in Garen's kit lifts him. His R is 120s and executes.

edits.before: Last Breath converts ANY knockup into a kill window — build your teamfight around that. Garen carry threat: 7/10 — anti-heal stays core, shift to picks and wave control if he gets ahead.
edits.after: Last Breath needs an airborne target and only your own Q2 whirlwind supplies one. Garen carry threat: 7/10 — anti-heal fights Perseverance, and shift to picks if he gets ahead.

edits.before: - Garen Courage: matchup-defining — Damage reduction. Trade when it’s down. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - Garen Courage: 22s at rank 1 — shield plus tenacity, so bait it before your knockup. - Decisive Strike is 8s and silences your dash. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.

edits.before: Damage reduction. Trade when it’s down. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: Shield plus tenacity for 22s at rank 1 — bait it, then commit the knockup.

notes: The page's existing 'Wind Wall does nothing here' framing is correct and I kept it — Garen genuinely has no projectile in any slot. Chart rows 1, 4 and 5 proposed as one paired group across both layers.
